data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in FRST and USCB.

FRST reported Q2 2026 net income of $9.4M versus $2.4M a year earlier (+286.8% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1325670/000110465926092672/0001104659-26-092672-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
